app.title: Gram Samadhan
app.subtitle: Village Grievance Reporting System
app.tagline: Simple, transparent problem reporting for your village

home.subtitle: A public service portal to submit village problems by voice or text and track official action transparently.
home.step1Desc: Select your village, press the mic to speak or type the problem in simple words.
home.step2Desc: Receive an instant tracking ID on your screen to check status anytime without passwords.
home.step3Desc: Your Gram Panchayat team reviews the issue, assigns workers, and updates the resolution.
home.helpSectionDesc: If you are having trouble submitting your complaint online, you can call the Panchayat helpdesk or visit during office hours.
home.helpLink: Read complete instructions & voice reporting guide

report.title: Report a Village Problem
report.subtitle: Fill in the details below or use your microphone to speak.
report.fullNamePlaceholder: Enter your full name (e.g. Ramesh Kumar)
report.mobileHelp: Used strictly to send official SMS status updates and for Panchayat staff to follow up. Never shared publicly.
report.phonePrivacyNotice: Privacy: Your phone number is strictly used for official SMS status updates and Panchayat resolution. It is never displayed publicly or shared.
report.voiceConsentNotice: Voice Privacy Notice: Your voice recording is processed securely solely to transcribe your grievance. Audio recordings are stored in encrypted private storage and automatically purged after resolution.
report.consentAgreement: I consent to the collection and processing of my contact and grievance details solely for official resolution under Gram Samadhan privacy guidelines.
report.consentRequired: Please check the consent box to proceed with complaint submission.
report.villagePlaceholder: Enter village name or ward (e.g. Sundarpur, Ward 4)
report.villageHelp: Default Panchayat location is pre-filled. You may edit if needed.
report.inputMethodLabel: Choose How to Submit Your Problem

success.title: Complaint Submitted Successfully!
success.subtitle: Your problem has been registered with the Gram Panchayat. Please note your reference number.
success.helpNote: You will need this reference ID to track progress or check updates.

help.title: Help & Instructions
help.subtitle: Guidelines on reporting complaints and using voice transcription.
help.rule1: Provide accurate village and ward location landmarks so workers can find the problem quickly.
help.rule2: Keep your reference number safe. It allows you to track progress at any time without logging in.
help.rule3: You can report issues regarding water supply, roads, streetlights, sanitation, electricity, health, or school facilities.
help.voiceTip1: When you click 'Press to Speak', your browser will ask for microphone permission. Click 'Allow'.
help.voiceTip2: Speak at a normal pace in a quiet environment for accurate transcription.
help.voiceTip3: You can speak in Hindi or English. The text will automatically appear in the description box.
help.officeHours: Office Hours: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
help.officeAddress: Gram Panchayat Office, Main Road, Tehsil Sundarpur
